detected_problem: Measured time is absent in all Chroma exports; six datasets show an elevated apparent series-path group.
engineer_action: Recover the Chroma recipe/sample clock and document force/sense wiring, voltage-tap locations, contacts, cable path, cell identity, and sensor locations; verify the fixture with a known load.
why_needed: Dynamic and thermal identification require measured time, and the observed voltage step cannot be assigned uniquely to cell, fixture, wiring, sensing, or fast polarization.
preliminary_protocol: Inventory existing configuration files and logs first. Before another cell test, verify current and voltage channels with a traceable load and confirm whether voltage sensing excludes force-lead drops.
safety_constraint: Do not execute a new cell recipe until the TRC18650 datasheet and tester limits are verified.
enables: Measured-time audit, defensible R_app,desc interpretation, cross-file synchronization decision, and go/no-go decision for reuse of existing runs.

detected_problem: No TRC18650 low-rate equilibrium-voltage reference is available.
engineer_action: Acquire one complete C/20 discharge with measured time and, preferably, a separate C/20 charge using the verified reference fixture.
why_needed: The loaded 1C curve cannot identify a cell-compatible OCP/voltage reference or effective electrode windows.
preliminary_protocol: Condition the cell under documented manufacturer limits; record current, voltage, Ah, measured time, surface temperature and ambient; retain initial/intermediate/final rests and cutoff events as separate segments. For Q=2.8999 Ah, C/20 is approximately 0.145 A.
safety_constraint: Use manufacturer voltage, current and temperature limits; the observed historical cutoffs are not a substitute for a datasheet.
active_execution_time_h: 20 discharge only; 40 for discharge plus charge
rest_time_h: not estimable until the recipe is fixed
preparation_time_h: not estimable until conditioning is specified
total_time_status: active time calculable; total laboratory time not yet established
enables: TRC capacity confirmation at low rate, voltage-reference/OCP compatibility gate, and effective state-window adaptation.
trigger_evidence: no low-rate TRC dataset in the seven-record inventory

detected_problem: The existing pulse test is partial, lacks measured time, and belongs to the elevated apparent-response group.
engineer_action: After fixture verification and the low-rate gate, acquire a clean timed HPPC profile across documented SOC levels.
why_needed: R0, diffusion/relaxation and kinetic groups cannot be separated from setup effects or identified without actual time.
preliminary_protocol: Use measured timestamps, SOC set by coulomb counting from a documented initial state, and at least 0.5C, 1C and 2C pulses with approximately 10 s pulse duration and approximately 20 min rest, following the supported Panasonic protocol structure. Reserve pulses/SOC levels for validation.
safety_constraint: Current levels require manufacturer approval and tester thermal/voltage limits; omit higher rates unless explicitly supported.
active_execution_time_h: not fully estimable; pulse active time is minor relative to conditioning
rest_time_h: 8.67 h minimum for 26 verified 20 min rest intervals
preparation_time_h: not estimable; SOC stepping and conditioning recipe required
total_time_status: Panasonic 25 °C reference span is 27.11 h, but it is not a directly transferable TRC duration
enables: TRC-specific conditional dynamic identification and held-out pulse validation.
trigger_evidence: no electrically calibration-ready dataset; existing pulse median R_app,desc is elevated

detected_problem: Surface and ambient temperatures exist, but there is no measured time and affected fixtures confound heat generation.
engineer_action: First try to recover the clock for the clean ambient cycle; otherwise repeat one 1C discharge and cooling rest with the verified fixture and documented sensors.
why_needed: Thermal storage and heat-transfer rate cannot be identified in capacity coordinates alone.
preliminary_protocol: Record measured time, current, voltage, Ah, central surface temperature, end surface temperature and chamber air continuously through discharge and cooling.
safety_constraint: Use manufacturer limits and stop criteria; monitor both cell surface and chamber temperature.
rest_time_h: not estimable until a cooling criterion is specified
enables: TRC thermal calibration or validation after electrical heat input is defensible.
trigger_evidence: all thermal calibration statuses are NOT SUITABLE

detected_problem: No independent TRC profile supports quantitative validation of an adapted model.
engineer_action: Reserve a complete cycle or acquire a dynamic profile not used in OCP, HPPC or thermal calibration.
why_needed: Calibration data cannot also establish independent predictive validity.
preliminary_protocol: Start from documented SOC, preserve bidirectional current if present, and record measured time, voltage, current, Ah, surface and ambient temperatures without fitting to the profile.
safety_constraint: Scale the profile to verified TRC current, voltage and temperature limits.
active_execution_time_h: 6.2355 h for the existing Panasonic UDDS reference only
rest_time_h: not estimable for a future TRC recipe
preparation_time_h: not estimable for a future TRC recipe
total_time_status: reference duration only; TRC total not established
enables: Independent electrical or electro-thermal validation of the adapted TRC model.
trigger_evidence: current files are characterization/diagnostic records, not an untouched adapted-model validation set
